api_url.description: Base URL of the RHEV-M (oVirt Engine) API endpoint.

username.description: Username (with domain, e.g., 'admin@internal' or 'user@domain') to authenticate against RHEV-M API.

password.description: Password for the RHEV-M API user. Store securely (e.g., via file permissions or vault integration).

domain.description: Authentication domain (e.g., 'internal' or 'example.com'). Leave blank to use the default domain.

ssl_verify.description: Enable SSL certificate verification. Set to false only for testing or with self-signed certs (not recommended in production).

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for API responses before timing out.

default_action.description: Default fence action (e.g., 'on', 'off', 'reboot', 'status', 'list') if not specified in the command line.

retry.description: Number of times to retry a failed fence action before giving up.

retry_sleep.description: Seconds to wait between retry attempts.

nodes.description: List of managed nodes (VMs or physical hosts) for which fence actions may be issued. Required for multi-node environments.

name.description: Human-readable identifier for the node (used for logging/debugging).

uuid.description: UUID of the virtual machine or host in RHEV-M (required for precise targeting).

host.description: Hostname or IP address used for out-of-band management (e.g., IPMI), if different from the VM’s network.
